in_hindi.long_meaning: हनिफाहात नाम अरबी मूल 'حنف' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है भटकने से बचना और सच्चे मार्ग पर चलना। कुरआन में حنفاء का उल्लेख उन लोगों के रूप में किया गया है जो ईश्वर के मार्ग पर चलते हैं। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो सच्चाई और धार्मिकता के साथ मार्ग चलता है।

in_pashto.name: حنيفاهات

in_pashto.long_meaning: حنيفاهات نوم د عربيې ريښې 'حنف' څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د ضلالت څخه د مخنیوي او د چاڼه لارې د تعقيب معنی ورکوي. په قرآن کريم کې، حنفاء هغه کسان دي چې د الله تعالی لارې ته متوجه شوي دي. دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې د حق او صداقت سره لارې ته ادامه ورکوي.

in_english.name: Hanifahaat
in_english.meaning: One who follows the straight path
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hanifahaat originates from the Arabic root 'حنف' (hanaf), which means to deviate from error and follow the straight path. In the Quran, al-Hunafaa' (الحنفاء) refer to those who adhere to the true and righteous path of Allah. The name signifies an individual committed to upholding truth, righteousness, and monotheism, reflecting a strong spiritual and moral stance.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Hanifahaat" holds significant cultural importance in Islamic traditions, referring to sincere monotheistic worshipers who were neither idolaters nor concealed Jews or Christians. It symbolizes a person who is committed to performing acts of worship in the purest form, as intended by Allah, without the influence of human or cultural interpretations. The term has roots in the early Islamic history, where it was used to describe the ancestors of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) who were considered to be monotheists by the Qur'an.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Hanifahaat" signifies a state of being sincerely and consciously connected to Allah Almighty. This connection is expressed through adherence to the teachings of the Qur'an and Sunnah in their purest forms, avoiding deviation due to personal desire or external influences. The term implies a strong commitment towards Tawheed - the Islamic concept of absolute oneness of Allah - and a striving for leads a virtuous life, which ultimately results in reaching a closer relationship with Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "One who is pure" symbolizes One who is free from sins and follows the straight path of Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hanifahaat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of one who is pure.
